name: jekyll-obsidian
description: Frontend assets and browser checks for the configurable Jekyll Obsidian template.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && vitest run && node --test tests/node/**/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && JEKYLL_ENV=production bin/build --url http://127.0.0.1:4173 --baseurl "" --destination _site-browser --skip-assets && playwright test
